columns.description: An unique reference number which is used to identify??entities??for tax-related purposes

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code for which this taxpayer id is registered.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Date from which the taxpayer record is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Date until which the taxpayer record is effective.

columns.description: Parent entity associated with taxpayer record.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.description: Digit used to validate the tax payer number.
